verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury is a banking-as-a-service API and dashboard for financial accounts, not an agent or AI host that would consume tools from MCP servers, so the MCP-client axis does not fit this product type. The documented official Stripe MCP server (probe-4) is a server-side capability that belongs to a separate story and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
